description: Minimal WAV replay manifest for the Media-mode speaker gate. Each scenario is a timeline of WAV segments (from the golden fixture set) replayed through MediaTurnController with the real fbank + ONNX pipeline. 'user' segments are the enrolled voice (en_a); 'media' segments are a different voice (zh_a/zh_b). Extend with recorded corpus WAVs for the full Phase 2 12-15 minute set.

enrollment.note: Profile centroid = embedding of the full user WAV (stand-in for the 6-clip enrollment; replaced by real enrollment clips when the recorded corpus lands).

scenarios.name: media-only
scenarios.description: Continuous other-voice media keeps VAD active; playback must never be cut.

scenarios.name: user-turn-in-silence
scenarios.description: A normal user utterance over silence commits and is accepted.

scenarios.name: short-command
scenarios.description: Under 1.2 s of voiced audio cannot trigger automatic interruption (hotkey path instead).

scenarios.name: mixed-user-over-media
scenarios.description: User starts during ongoing media speech; exactly one commit, verified turn accepted.
